name: Pokémon Cursed Version
storyline:
It was Halloween night. Children laughing and screaming in the night, while they trick or treat. A perfect Halloween night. Or that’s what I thought, until I went out to join them. All I wanted was to trick or treat and then go challenge the gym. It could’ve been simple. But I just had to go snooping around where I shouldn’t have.

I mean, what was I thinking? A 16-year-old hunting ghosts? Just a silly game most would think. I thought that too until I met the ghost that killed me…
summary: Short Story! This is great for people who just want to have fun and not commit to a 12-hour story!
